title: Read-only billing resolution attempt + official free-tier mapping (no spend, no token exposure)
method: Authenticated read-only GET over official Replicate API + public first-party pages. Token in env only; never printed/logged; all probe output redacted.

billingSignalsViaOfficialAPI.GET /v1/account: 200 — exposes ONLY {type:user, username:naser636, name, avatar_url, github_url}. NO billing/credit/plan/limit field. No billing header (only ratelimit-remaining/reset).
billingSignalsViaOfficialAPI.GET /v1/predictions: 200 — count 0: the account has NEVER run a prediction (free-trial allowance intact).
billingSignalsViaOfficialAPI.GET /v1/hardware: 200 — SKU+name only, NO prices via API.
billingSignalsViaOfficialAPI.modelObjectFields: No per-model 'free'/'billing'/'price' flag. Prediction schema DOES carry 'is_free_trial_prediction' (Replicate tags free-trial runs) — but only visible AFTER a run is created.
billingSignalsViaOfficialAPI.conclusion: NO official read-only API exposes the account's payment-method / billing-mode / free-trial-allowance state. Exhaustively confirmed.

accountPages: The authenticated billing dashboard is session-cookie web (the API token does not authenticate it); not machine-readable by ODG. CTO reports the 'Manage billing' button is NOT visible — consistent with (not proof of) no billing set up.

officialFreeTier.policyVerbatim: Free for a LIMITED number of runs per account; after the limit you must add billing & purchase credit. Does NOT require a payment method upfront.

SC43-fr-voice.note: Only free TTS is resemble-ai/chatterbox (French capability UNVERIFIED; primarily English). French+emotion model minimax/speech-02-hd is NOT free-tier. GAP.

eligibilityVsGuaranteedGratuity.documentedEligibility: VERIFIED for minimax/video-01 + flux-dev (present in try-for-free).
eligibilityVsGuaranteedGratuity.guaranteedGratuity: NOT CONFIRMABLE: free only for an unpublished, per-account limited number of runs; remaining allowance is not exposed by any official API. Gratuity is guaranteed ONLY while NO payment method is attached (then over-limit => blocked, never charged). Payment-method status is the single unverifiable fact.

chargeRiskAnalysis.noPaymentMethod: Replicate cannot charge; free-tier models run free until limit then 402 (no charge); auto-reload & prepaid BOTH require a card => impossible. => €0, zero risk.
chargeRiskAnalysis.paymentMethodAttached: free trial may be consumed / billing active => a run could charge (bounded by ledger); prepaid+auto-reload+low-balance could trigger a prohibited purchase.
chargeRiskAnalysis.decisiveUnknown: Is a payment card attached to the Replicate account? Not exposed by any official read-only API.

verdict: BLOCKED at €0. No official read-only control confirms a zero-charge path (payment-method status is not API-exposed). confirmedBillingArrears NOT modified. Adapter guards unchanged.
singleAlternativeAction: CTO states a binary they already know from their own actions (no button-hunting): was a payment card / billing EVER added to this Replicate account? If NEVER: combined with API-verified 0 predictions + Replicate's documented 'no payment method required upfront', this is verifiable proof that NO charge is possible => ODG runs the 4 free-tier-eligible prototypes (SC40/SC22 via minimax/video-01; SC01/SC39/SC48 via flux-dev) at guaranteed €0, inspecting is_free_trial_prediction on each. SC43 French voice remains separately BLOCKED (no free French-emotion TTS) pending either billing authorization for minimax/speech-02-hd or acceptance of chatterbox with measured French quality.
